rv.q: This energetic, funny, and unforgettable production is well worth booking now.

Darkly funny with a talented cast to boot, this cult classic will have you laughing when you shouldn’t and reflecting on your teenage years and the emotional rollercoaster of those raging hormones and the complexities of adolescent friendships.
Heathers is darkly comic fun, performed by a talented cast.
Nearly four decades after its original setting, Heathers remains a surprisingly timely exploration of adolescence.
The plot may be dark, but the music is upbeat, and the cast are enthusiastic and very talented.
Heathers is a gloriously easy watch: camp, energetic and witty, you are guaranteed an enjoyable night at the theatre.

Offering feel-good fun with sinister undertones, toxic teenage angst and more than a smattering of mature themes, Heathers The Musical is the perfect excuse to dig out your snazzy plaid, matching socks and scrunchies, snack on corn nuts, and be 17 again – whether you ever felt ‘normal’ or not.
Paired with an outstanding score, Heathers remains a genuinely successful musical, and this latest production continues to possess a distinctive energy entirely its own.
Kevin Murphy and Laurence O’Keefe’s score, which makes light of elements of the plot, is sometimes serviceable over being memorable.
This is a show that will have you bopping along from the first note to the last.
Quibbles with the script aside, this is an impressive production with some immense vocal talent that is disturbingly joyful to watch.

cn.t: Critics generally praise this crowd-pleasing return of Heathers for its dark humor, catchy songs, and strong performances, though some note the new Marble Arch venue's sound issues distract from the show.
